tokens.name: bg-canvas
tokens.usage: Page background of every pivoshenko.* site.

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles, callouts, swatches and code blocks — always with border-card and shadow-rest so it reads as a surface, not a tint.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: A step above bg-surface: tags, hovered rows, pressed controls, the card glyph tile.

tokens.name: bg-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: the header on scroll, inputs, the terminal title bar.

tokens.name: bg-overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim fill for dialogs and image lightboxes (use at 80% opacity).

tokens.name: fg-default
tokens.usage: Titles and primary copy on bg-canvas, bg-surface and bg-raised (12.8:1 on bg-canvas).

tokens.name: fg-muted
tokens.usage: Body paragraphs on bg-canvas and bg-surface (7.9:1 on bg-canvas).

tokens.name: fg-subtle
tokens.usage: Nav links, meta, dates, section labels on bg-canvas and bg-surface (5.5:1 on bg-canvas). Use this — not fg-faint — for any small text.

tokens.name: fg-faint
tokens.usage: Source value kept: only 3.4:1 on bg-canvas (2.7:1 on bg-raised), so it FAILS for body-size text. Use for decorative glyphs, separators, disabled states and text 24px+ only; the current sites set dates in it — move those to fg-subtle.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Card and header outlines, hairline rules.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Dividers inside a surface, table rows.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Hovered cards, input outlines (decorative: pair with a label; not a 3:1 control border).

tokens.name: border-card
tokens.usage: The outline of a raised surface (overlay0 at 60%): cards, tiles, callouts, swatches, tags, menus and the code block. Visible against bg-canvas without reading as a heavy box.

tokens.name: accent-primary
tokens.usage: The default `--accent`: links on hover, active nav marker, focus ring, highlighted words, index contour lines. Any site or section can point `--accent` at another palette slot with `data-accent`. Passes for text on bg-canvas, bg-surface and bg-raised (6.7:1 / 6:1 / 5.2:1).

tokens.name: accent-secondary
tokens.usage: Second highlight: star counts, index contour lines, inline code keywords.

tokens.name: accent-success
tokens.usage: Positive status: "in sync", "published". Always with a word or glyph; green and danger red differ in hue only, so never tell them apart by colour alone.

tokens.name: accent-warning
tokens.usage: Caution status: "draft", "archived". Always with a word or glyph.

tokens.name: accent-danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions. Always with a word or glyph. 5.7:1 on bg-canvas, 5.1:1 on bg-surface and 4.5:1 on bg-raised — on bg-raised use it for icons, borders and 19px+ bold text, not small copy.

tokens.name: accent-info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices and info callouts (sapphire, 6.1:1 on bg-canvas).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on an accent fill (≥5.7:1 on every accent).

tokens.name: accent-glow
tokens.usage: Soft spotlight that follows the cursor on cards; hero caret halo. Never behind text as its only contrast.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: ::selection background; text stays fg-default.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Sticky header backdrop (with a 12px blur) and lightbox scrim.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero title on landing pages. One per page.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Hero title on inner pages; hero title on mobile.

styles.name: display-md

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, nav links, the VP mark, inline code. Source: Tailwind rounded.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, swatches.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, wallpaper tiles, terminal windows.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots and count pills only.

shadow.note: Borders and a lit top edge carry structure; shadows lift. Every raised surface rests on shadow-rest.

tokens.name: shadow-rest
tokens.usage: The resting state of every raised surface — cards, tiles, tags, callouts, swatches, menus. The inset line lights the top edge so a surface separates from bg-canvas without a heavy border.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Hovered cards and tiles.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Terminal windows, menus, lightboxes.

duration.note: Motion timing. Every animation stops under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Color and opacity on hover.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Card lift, arrow nudge, nav marker slide.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Hero entrance, staggered list reveal.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Entrances and hover lifts.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Marker slides and theme cross-fades.
